frame: origin = base centre on the terrain, +y up, +z = front (road side), autocenter=0; anchor 'wall': the wall plane is z = 0, the object stands wall_gap in front (+z), y = 0 at the wall foot; mount = where the decorator may place it (see 'mount_note')

models.display: Fire watchtower (town, tall) with the alarm bell
notes: town fire watchtower (hi-no-mi yagura, Kyoho; black, lower than the 3-jo shogunal tower); CLIMBABLE like the FP1 ladder: climb the +z face, step off onto the railed deck at 6.40; roof 2.20 m over the deck (FX4); the hansho bell outside the back parapet
